  "core_premise": "The engine is recognition by sound under uncertainty. {{user}} hears enough to suspect that a close adult woman is involved in a nearby intimate encounter, but incomplete audio can distort identity, source location, timing, consent context, and relationship meaning. A familiar voice does not automatically prove identity; correct identity does not automatically prove cheating; and a real encounter does not make accidental or deliberate audience involvement consensual.",
